**L-1661 (Pascual Jaime Escobar Murillo): converted.**

- Realistically the review will finish after the quarter closes.

I haven't escalated to Compliance because no sanctions hit or other flag requires it. If the Branch Manager wants a Compliance view on the referral pressure, that's a call for him to make.

I've closed the shift and saved a handover note. The note says to re-run KYC and open the account once EDD clears.
